options.name: Aberrant Bloodline
options.benefit: An alien or unnatural ancestry reshapes the sorcerer's body and magic. Grants the Aberrant bloodline arcana, powers, bonus spells, and bonus-feat list as they are earned.

options.name: Abyssal Bloodline
options.benefit: Demonic influence fuels destructive strength and summoning magic. Grants the Abyssal bloodline arcana, powers, bonus spells, and bonus-feat list as they are earned.

options.name: Arcane Bloodline
options.benefit: Raw magical talent runs unusually pure and responds strongly to metamagic. Grants the Arcane bloodline arcana, powers, bonus spells, and bonus-feat list as they are earned.

options.name: Celestial Bloodline
options.benefit: Good-aligned outsider ancestry empowers protective and radiant magic. Grants the Celestial bloodline arcana, powers, bonus spells, and bonus-feat list as they are earned.

options.name: Destined Bloodline
options.benefit: Fate marks the sorcerer for greatness and bends chance around key moments. Grants the Destined bloodline arcana, powers, bonus spells, and bonus-feat list as they are earned.

options.name: Draconic Bloodline
options.benefit: Draconic ancestry grants an energy affinity and progressively more dragon-like abilities. Grants the Draconic bloodline arcana, powers, bonus spells, and bonus-feat list as they are earned.

options.name: Elemental Bloodline
options.benefit: An elemental ancestor aligns the sorcerer with air, earth, fire, or water. Grants the Elemental bloodline arcana, powers, bonus spells, and bonus-feat list as they are earned.

options.name: Fey Bloodline
options.benefit: Fey influence strengthens enchantment, woodland magic, and capricious supernatural abilities. Grants the Fey bloodline arcana, powers, bonus spells, and bonus-feat list as they are earned.

options.name: Infernal Bloodline
options.benefit: Devilish ancestry encourages control, corruption, and resistance to flame. Grants the Infernal bloodline arcana, powers, bonus spells, and bonus-feat list as they are earned.

options.name: Undead Bloodline
options.benefit: Undeath taints the bloodline and alters how mind-affecting magic interacts with corporeal undead. Grants the Undead bloodline arcana, powers, bonus spells, and bonus-feat list as they are earned.

options.name: Aquatic Bloodline
options.benefit: Oceanic ancestry grants water magic, aquatic adaptation, telepathy with sea creatures, and mastery of the deep.

options.name: Boreal Bloodline
options.benefit: Ancestry from frozen lands empowers cold magic, ice travel, snow shrouds, and the endurance of ancient winter.
